name: szivecske-anonymizer
description: „Szivecske Anonimizáló”, a Windows desktop program (Electron) that pseudonymises Hungarian legal documents (PDF and Word) on the owner's machine; nothing goes to the internet; one area per top-level folder.

glossary.spike: the spike and its synthetic output
glossary.scripts: the helper scripts (the old auto-commit among them)
glossary.root: a file at the top: README.md, SPIKE.md, package.json, package-lock.json, the Vite and TypeScript configs
